verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents one-off asynchronous transcription jobs created via API, MCP, or x402, with webhook and SSE completion updates. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring or scheduled jobs or workflows. The Google Drive automations run through Zapier, a third-party platform, not the product's own scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
